Transformers v5.20.1 adds support for Reflection Beam, an open-weight model optimized for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks. You can deploy Beam on AWS using SageMaker JumpStart endpoints, or run it on distributed GPU infrastructure via SGLang and vLLM. The release also resolves a bug impacting model loading on older torch versions. #AI #MachineLearning #AWS #Kubernetes
